question: Reshma alone can do a work in 14 days. Bhavana is 40% more efficient than Reshma. The number of days, Bhavana alone will take to do the same piece of work is:
solution:
**Given:-**

Reshma alone can do a work in 14 days. Bhavana is 40% more efficient than Reshma

**Formula used:-**

Total work = efficiency × time 

 

**Calculation:-**

The ratio of efficiency of Bhavana and Reshma= 140 ∶ 100

So, Total work done by Reshma = 14 × 100 = 1400 units

Bhavana alone will take to do the same piece of work is = 1400/140 

⇒ 10 

**∴ The required answer is __10.__**
